why.R01: The catalogue is a standard every team must meet; a design that uses an unadmitted model does not conform.
why.R02: Photos are Restricted; the placement rule forbids an external host whatever the path.
why.R03: A gate exists, so it is not non-compliance; it measures the wrong thing for the top scenario.
why.R04: One parameter, the provider's latency, decides whether the latency scenario is met.
why.R05: One decision moves latency and cost one way and quality the other.
why.R06: The oversight scenario is met by design.
why.R07: Storage placement meets the rule for Restricted data.
why.R08: Nobody reviews or answers for template changes.
why.R09: If the sample rate falls, rubber-stamping becomes invisible: the oversight scenario rests on this number.
why.R10: A leak in either client means revoking both: the leak is not contained to one client.
why.R11: Privacy against cost and time to service.
why.R12: The data terms meet the catalogue's criteria.
